credits.holder: Karrie Berglund (Digitalis Education Solutions, Inc.), after John MacDonald
credits.work: Stellarium sky culture 'Inuit', based primarily on John MacDonald, The Arctic Sky: Inuit Astronomy, Star Lore and Legend
credits.note: Licence line of the culture's description: 'Text and data: GNU GPL v2.0'. Only text and data are used here; the illustrations (Johan Meuris, 'Free Art License') are not part of this import. Stellarium main repository commit e233fa9b3d21e2cafe9c168e6710b627532a7dd4, folder skycultures/; Converted to sky positions and separate segments; other changes: see 'Made for this viewer'.

credits.work: d3-celestial star and deep-sky positions (stars.6.json, stars.8.json, dsos.6.json)
credits.note: Used only to turn Hipparcos numbers and DSO names into positions; stars.8.json (magnitude 8 and brighter, same project, same BSD-3-Clause licence) supplies the numbers that stars.6.json lacks (identical positions on all 5044 shared stars). Licence file quoted: 'Copyright (c) 2015, Olaf Frohn. All rights reserved.' Star data of that project derive from the Hipparcos catalogue; positions only are used here. The dsos files were read from the master branch on the import date (not a pinned commit).

credits.holder: The Stellarium project and its translators
credits.work: Translations of the 'Inuit' figure names (and the culture's name, where given): po/stellarium-skycultures/{de,es,fr,it,ja,nb,pl,pt,pt_BR,ru,tr,uk,zh_CN,zh_TW}.po and po/stellarium-skycultures-descriptions/, written as de, es, fr, it, ja, nb, pl, pt, pt-BR, ru, tr, uk, zh-Hans, zh-Hant
credits.note: Repository licence: COPYING (GNU GPL version 2) at the pinned commit; codemeta.json: '"license": "https://spdx.org/licenses/GPL-2.0-or-later"'. The .po files carry no licence header of their own. The translated English names are the culture's own (see the entries above for their licence). Matched by msgid = the English name, checked against the .pot comment 'Inuit constellation/asterism'; fuzzy, empty, equal-to-English and over-64-character entries not used; no key in the culture's own language.

credits.work: zh-Hant of 2 figures converted from their zh-Hans (Stellarium) names. Simplified-to-Traditional (Taiwan standard) conversion of zh-Hans names into zh-Hant: dictionaries STPhrases, STCharacters, TWVariantsPhrases, TWVariants (the s2tw chain), applied for this viewer; TSCharacters, TSPhrases and JPShinjitaiCharacters used only to compare characters
credits.note: LICENSE: 'Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004'; each dictionary file: '# License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE)'. The generated STPhrases_GeneratedFromRegionalPhrases dictionary is not in the repository and was not used.

credits.work: Draft translations of figure names, not from a source: fr 2, it 2, ja 4, nb 2, pl 2, pt 2, tr 2, uk 1; the culture's name in 6 languages

credits.work: Changes to the imported stick lines and label points
credits.note: 4 one-star figures (the source writes the star twice) kept as one zero-length line. Label points: the centre of the segment ends. Stroke order, direction and timing (t0/t1) made for this viewer; no end point moved.

credits.work: Kana readings over the Japanese names (ja)
